evidence.quote: DM: Okay. So, as the sun sinks in the sky, turning the walls of the canyon a golden red, you all are standing looking at the dead bodies of Agata Dustmother and her servant Samerki.

DM: It has only been a few minutes now since you emerged from Shakun's realm, at the prompting of Jumi, now a strange wooden puppet child, to find Cintra facing off against Agata and Samerki. Despite the swarm of locusts, the freezing blast of cold that nearly killed Seeker and Kenzo, and Wellby turned into a centipede and scooped up in a glass jar, you managed to defeat these foes.

DM: Now, as you stand catching your breath Cintra runs into the wellspring and emerges with Shakun's heart and her daughter still mostly made of wood. She is holding Jumi, tears streaming down her face, as she looks in relief and horror at her daughter, alive and yet seemingly transformed by Agata into something that is not quite human. You can hear her murmuring, “You are safe now. It will all be okay now.” But to your ears, it is clear there is a note of doubt in her voice.
